title: O002-S1 CASE Nonlinear Model-Class Sensitivity
purpose: Test whether the O002 no-peripheral-increment result is an artifact of linear Ridge regression under the exact same CASE windows, features, LOSO split, and strong stimulus+time+prior-report baseline.
input_generation: Re-run frozen O002 extraction only; do not alter windows/features.
outer: Leave-one-subject-out, identical 30 CASE participants if frozen QC passes.
preprocessing: One-hot categorical controls, median imputation and standardization fit only on each outer training set.

decision.NONLINEAR_PERIPHERAL_INCREMENT: At least one learner/axis has delta 95% CI strictly above zero.
decision.ROBUST_NO_PERIPHERAL_INCREMENT: No learner/axis has delta CI strictly above zero.
decision.STRONG_DEGRADATION: All learner/axis delta CIs strictly below zero.

firewall: Post-primary sensitivity only. It cannot redefine O002 primary. No feature/window changes.
